§6Energy Upgrade§f

§aCuts power consumption without changing processing speed.§f
The §bEnergy Upgrade§f reduces FE consumption per recipe while keeping processing time the same. Pair it with Speed Upgrades to offset the extra power draw, or use it standalone to save energy on machines that aren't time-critical.

Craft them with §bLapis§f, §bRedstone§f, and a §bLight Weighted Pressure Plate§f. Same cost as Speed Upgrades, different pressure plate.

The practical difference: Speed Upgrades make things faster but hungrier. Energy Upgrades make things cheaper but don't speed anything up. The optimal setup is usually a mix of both, depending on how much power you have spare.

§ePS:§f If you're power-limited, Energy Upgrades are the better first investment. Speed can wait until your generation is solid.
